instruction: Please change VLC's interface slider colors to a dark theme. Make all the slider colors blackish (each RGB component should be below 100).

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.verification: Verified that check_qt_slider_colours with type='blackish' checks VLC config file vlcrc and parses qt-slider-colours as semicolon-separated RGB triplets, ensuring each color has all RGB components < 100.
